## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: Migrator emits reminder to git add sentinel if .claude/ gitignored (test side)

## Implementation Notes
This task adds tests to tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh — the test file created/extended by story 6748-7ceb-1383-4ce5 (S2). If that file does not yet exist when this task executes (S2 not yet merged), create it as a new test file following the same structure as tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh (source tests/lib/assert.sh, use mktemp fixtures, call print_summary at end).

Tests to add:
1. `test_migrator_emits_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_gitignored` —
   Given: a fixture git repo where .gitignore contains `.claude/` (or `.claude`) AND migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh exists
   When: migrator runs on a fixture config with the four legacy keys
   Then: stderr output from the migrator contains the reminder string (e.g., "git add" or "sentinel" or "gitignored")

2. `test_migrator_no_reminder_when_not_gitignored` —
   Given: same fixture repo WITHOUT .claude/ in .gitignore
   When: migrator runs
   Then: stderr does NOT contain the reminder

Implementation note: use `git check-ignore` or inspect the .gitignore file directly in the test to simulate the gitignore check. The test must invoke the actual migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh script, not mock it.

Update .test-index:
- plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh:[test_migrator_emits_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_gitignored] tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh:[test_migrator_no_reminder_when_not_gitignored] tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh

## TDD Requirement
RED test task — write tests that FAIL before Task 4 is implemented. These tests must fail because the reminder logic does not yet exist in the migrator.

Given: fixture git repo with .claude/ in .gitignore, fixture dso-config.conf with merge.strategy=direct
When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh runs on the fixture
Then: stderr contains reminder about git add for the sentinel

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass after Task 4 is implemented (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] test_migrator_emits_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_gitignored function exists in test file
  Verify: grep -q 'test_migrator_emits_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_gitignored' tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- [ ] test_migrator_no_reminder_when_not_gitignored function exists in test file
  Verify: grep -q 'test_migrator_no_reminder_when_not_gitignored' tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- [ ] Tests currently fail RED (before Task 4 implementation)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL:.*gitignore\|FAIL:.*reminder'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for both new test functions
  Verify: grep -c '\[test_migrator.*gitignore\|test_migrator.*reminder' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index" | awk '{exit ($1 < 2)}'
- [ ] Test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
